mentions.name: PhotoFig
mentions.description: A product-photo editor for online sellers that cleans up large batches of product images. It offers automated background removal plus first-class masking with SAM-assisted selection and a precise manual brush for corrections. The backend and storage are self-hosted on owned hardware, including a Kubernetes operator that bin-packs GPU workloads across workers.
mentions.problem: Existing tools could remove backgrounds automatically but didn't give enough control when the result needed correcting; the author's wife had to carefully mask product photos for her online shop.
mentions.audience: Online sellers who need to clean up hundreds of images for their shops.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on PhotoFig: https://photofig.com, a recently launched product-photo editor for online sellers who need to clean up hundreds of images.
mentions.author: karolist
